pkgmetadata.longdescription:
TypeScript Language Server exposes the TypeScript tsserver through the Language Server Protocol, giving any LSP-capable editor completion, diagnostics, navigation and refactoring for TypeScript and JavaScript projects.
tsserver is not bundled. The server uses the project's own typescript when it has one, a tsserver.path given by the client, and otherwise the system dev-lang/typescript, which is linked into the install directory for that purpose.
